The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 2207c8250f6c6416), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 2. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. statement: There is a universal constant Cap > 0 such that for every 0 < ε < 1 there is an integer R(ε) ≤ Capε−6 with the following property. Let M ⊆ B(H) be a complex von Neumann algebra, let A ⊆ M be a MASA, and let x = x∗ ∈ M. For every finite F ⊂ H and every δ > 0, there exist y = y∗ ∈ M, a partition P = (pi) R(ε) i=1 of the unit in A, and a = a∗ ∈ A, such that ∥y∥ ≤ 3 ∥x∥ , ∥(y − x)ξ∥ < δ (ξ ∈ F), and ∥a∥ ≤ ∥y∥ , ∥CP(y) − a∥ ≤ ε ∥y∥ . Zero projections may be included in the partition.
